paper.title: Orb: A Fast, Scalable Neural Network Potential

result.summary: 本文介绍了 Orb，一族用于材料原子尺度建模的通用原子间势 [abstract]。Orb 采用可扩展的图神经网络架构，通过扩散预训练和 NNP 微调两阶段训练 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。在 Matbench Discovery 基准上，Orb 发布时相比其他方法误差降低 31%，并在多种硬件上比现有通用势快 3-6 倍 [abstract]。Orb 在几何优化、蒙特卡洛和分子动力学模拟中均得到评估，并在小分子和晶体材料的 MD 中表现出稳定性 [abstract][S3.SS4.p1][S3.SS5.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在解决从头算计算方法设计无机材料速度慢、难以扩展到实际尺寸系统的问题 [S1.p1]。其动机是深度学习方法有望在保持从头算精度的同时大幅提升速度和可扩展性 [S1.p1]。Orb 的关键创新是将可扩展的图神经网络架构应用于材料建模，从数据中学习原子相互作用的复杂性及其不变性，而非使用受架构约束的旋转等变或特定群对称性模型 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, ab initio computational methods for designing new inorganic materials are slow and scale poorly to realistically sized systems.
New methods using deep learning offer a way to achieve ab initio accuracy with dramatically increased speed and scalability.

Our key innovation in Orb is to adapt this approach to materials modeling, focusing on a scalable graph neural network architecture which learns the complexity of atomic interactions and their invariances from data, rather than using architecturally constrained models which respect rotational equivariance or particular group symmetries.

method.text: Orb 的主干是图网络模拟器（GNS），并加入了平滑图注意力机制，节点间的消息基于注意力权重和距离截断函数更新 [S2.p1]。模型分为编码器、处理器和解码器三阶段，解码器通过三个独立 MLP 预测总能量、每原子力和应力 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。训练分两阶段：先以基态材料数据集进行去噪扩散预训练，再微调为预测能量、力和应力的神经网络势 [S2.SS3.p1]。由于模型非保守，直接预测力，推理时需进行净力归零和净扭矩移除调整 [S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p2][S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The backbone of Orb is a Graph Network Simulator (GNS) augmented with a smoothed graph attention mechanism, where messages between nodes are updated based on both attention weights and distance-based cutoff functions.
The model is composed of three stages: an Encoder, Processor, and Decoder.
The Decoder takes the output of the Processor and predicts the next state of the system by projecting the node representations $\mathbf{v}_{i}$ using 3 independent MLPs

Orb models are trained in two distinct phases - first they are trained as Denoising Diffusion models using a dataset of ground state materials. Secondly, the base models are used to initialize a Neural Network Potential which predicts the energy, forces and stress of systems and is trained in a supervised manner.
At inference time, our model requires a single forward pass to produce $E,\mathbf{f}_{i}$ and $\boldsymbol{\sigma}$, as we do not implement our forcefield as a conservative vector field.
• $\mathbf{\hat{f}}_{i}{f}_{i}-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\mathbf{f}_{i}$ ( net zero force) • $\mathbf{\tilde{f}}_{i}^{\text{pred}}=\mathbf{\hat{f}}_{i}+\delta\mathbf{f}_{i}$ ( net torque removal)

experiments.text: Orb 在 Matbench-Discovery 基准上评估，该基准要求模型将晶体结构弛豫到基态并预测分解能 [S3.SS1.p1]。在 MD17-10k 基准上评估小分子 NVT 分子动力学，包括系统特定微调和零样本设置 [S3.SS4.p1][S3.SS4.SSSx2.p1]。在 MOF-5 上评估不同温度下的 MD 稳定性，温度范围 300 K 到 800 K [S3.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。在 Mg-MOF-74 上使用 Widom 插入评估 CO2 吸附，使用 Orb-D3 模型 [S3.SS6.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We evaluate Orb on the widely adopted Matbench-Discovery benchmark. This is a high-throughput geometry optimization and stability prediction benchmark that demands accurate estimates of energies, forces, and stress tensors at ab initio fidelity.
We evaluate Orb on the MD17-10k benchmark, following the protocol of.
Training system specific models is expensive and unscalable. It is therefore of interest to directly evaluate Orb without additional finetuning.
Here, we show that Orb produces stable MD trajectories for MOF-5 across a range of different temperatures.
To investigate the adsorption properties of Mg-MOF-74 at low pressures, we use Widom insertion using Orb-D3 to compute the heat of adsorption and free energy landscape of $\text{CO}_{2}$.

findings.text: 在 Matbench Discovery 上，Orb 模型在主要指标 F1 上创下新 state-of-the-art，并具有特别高的精度 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。扩散预训练普遍提升性能，改进幅度在 17% 到 70% 之间 [S3.F2]。Orb 在大系统尺寸下比 MACE 快 3 到 6 倍 [S3.F3]。在 MD17-10k 上，系统特定 Orb 模型对所有分子达到最大 300 ps 稳定性，与 NequIP 相当 [S3.SS4.SSSx1.Px1.p1]。零样本评估中，Orb (MPtraj) 在仅用 MPtraj 训练的模型中表现最佳 [S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px1.p1]。在 MOF-5 上，Orb 在 300-800 K 范围内产生稳定轨迹，并复现了实验观察到的苯环旋转受限行为 [S3.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。在 Mg-MOF-74 吸附中，Orb-D3 的吸附热为 -54.9 kJ/mol，比 MACE 的 -61.7 kJ/mol 更接近实验值 -44 kJ/mol [S3.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: For both sections, Orb models set a new state-of-the art across the primary metric (F1), and are generally superior across other metrics.

Orb models have especially high precision, which would likely be crucial in a real-world use-case where false-positives (i.e. materials that are predicted as stable but are not) are very costly due to wasted experimental effort.
Diffusion pretraining helps universally with improvements between 17% and 70%, even on Alexandria, which is an order of magnitude larger MPtraj.
At large system sizes, Orb is between 3 to 6 times faster than MACE.
Orb demonstrates excellent stability, achieving the maximum 300ps for all molecules, putting it on par with NequIP and ahead of all other baseline models.
Comparing just those models trained on MPtraj, we see that Orb has the best performance, with a lower $h(r)$ across the board.
Here, we show that Orb produces stable MD trajectories for MOF-5 across a range of different temperatures.
We observe no complete rotation of the phenylene ring to occur between 300-800 K.
In contrast, Orb-D3’s shallower wells closer to the experimental value, with a heat of adsorption of -54.9 kJ/mol.
This extra depth leads to a low heat of adsorption (-61.7 kJ/mol) compared to the experimental value of -44 kJ/mol.

limitations.text: 论文指出，零样本 MD17 评估中所有模型性能接近，从四个模拟的样本量难以稳健判断优劣 [S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px2.p1]。作者还提到，将 Alexandria 加入 Orb 训练集反而降低性能，这一结果在更大分子样本上可能不具统计显著性 [S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px2.p1]。在吸附评估中，作者认为需要进一步微调数据才能获得定量正确的吸附热 [S3.SS6.SSS0.Px4.p1]。此外，作者表示仅通过基态扩散建模触及了该方法的表面，使用完整轨迹数据是未来有前景的方向 [S4.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1]。

evidence.quote: Whilst Orb (MPtraj) does outperform MACE and Sevennet (Table 3), all models are reasonably close in performance and it is hard to make a robust judgement of superiority from a sample size of four simulations.
Indeed, the somewhat surprising result that adding in Alexandria to Orb’s training set lowers performance may not be statistically significant across a larger sample of molecules.

The higher interaction energies and heats of adsorption suggest that further fine-tuning data may be required to get quantitatively correct heats of adsorption for sampling the potential energy landscape using Monte Carlo methods

Arguably, we have only scratched the surface of this approach through our use of diffusion modeling on ground-states, and we believe that the use of full trajectory data is a promising direction for future work.
